rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for gathering information or experience without stressing the gradual process.

example.english: I glean useful information by interviewing different residents.
example.traditional: 我靠訪問唔同街坊，慢慢收集到好多有用資料。
example.jyutping: ngo5 kaau3 fong2 man6 m4 tung4 gaai1 fong1 maan6 maan2 sau1 zaap6 dou3 hou2 do1 jau5 jung6 zi1 liu2

rows.jyutping: zuk6 siu2 zuk6 siu2 gam3 sau1 zaap6
rows.note: Use this when emphasizing that information or experience is accumulated little by little, often with difficulty.

example.english: I glean practical experience little by little by working with senior colleagues.
example.traditional: 我跟住前輩做，逐少逐少咁收集到實戰經驗。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gan1 zyu6 cin4 bui3 zou6 zuk6 siu2 zuk6 siu2 gam3 sau1 zaap6 dou3 sat6 zin3 ging1 jim6

rows.note: Use this for picking up leftover crops or produce after the main harvest.

example.english: After the harvest, the villagers still glean the vegetables left in the fields.
example.traditional: 收割完之後，村民仲會去田入面執拾剩低嘅菜。
example.jyutping: sau1 got3 jyun4 zi1 hau6 cyun1 man4 zung6 wui5 heoi3 tin4 jap6 min6 zap1 sap6 zing6 dai1 ge3 coi3
